issues: No evasion of the measurement: no file or network access, no pasted answers, no use of test labels. Added features are SMARTS substructure counts and descriptors computed per-molecule from the SMILES alone.
Descriptor offset stays consistent: nd is incremented by N_EXTRA = len(EXTRA_SMARTS) + 3, which matches the 25 SMARTS counts plus 3 extra values appended in featurize.
Minor redundancy, not a bug: the last extra feature re-counts EXTRA_SMARTS[16], duplicating a column already present.
Candidate is worse than incumbent (0.3659 vs 0.3618 mean of 2 runs); recomputed z about -0.90, consistent with the reported -0.884, so the reject decision holds.
